findings.label: Keyboard entry flips the chevron's meaning
findings.detail: Tabbing into the composer from the compact state lands on #quickAddToggle (the close button is not tabbable there), which enters add mode and opens the details, so the button relabels to 'Ukryj opis' with aria-expanded="true" and the user's first Enter collapses the row they were reaching for (measured as harness rows c3/c4). keepDesc is pointer-only by design. Consider applying keepDesc to any entry whose focus target is the toggle, letting the activation open the row in both input modes.

findings.label: Chevron press-and-cancel leaves details collapsed in add mode
findings.detail: A pointerdown on the chevron marks the focusin entry it causes as keepDesc, so if no click follows (pointer dragged off the button, pointer cancel) add mode is on with the description never opened - the one entry path that does not satisfy 'details open on entering add mode'. The existing 700ms safety timer only clears the flag; it could also open the row when it fires while still in add mode and nothing toggled it. Not covered by the harness.

findings.label: descDismissed is write-only
findings.detail: descDismissed is set in enterAddMode, exitAddMode and the chevron click handler but read nowhere. The 'stays collapsed for the rest of the add-mode session' rule now rests entirely on enterAddMode's early return when add mode is already on. Either drop the flag or gate the re-expand on it, so a future entry path cannot silently reopen the row with nothing failing.

findings.label: Two pages still load tab-bar-functions.js?v=16
findings.detail: leaderboard.html:1509 and wiadomosci.html:840 both carry a 'Dodaj' tab and both still request ?v=16, so their Dodaj tab navigates without ?add=1 until the cached copy is revalidated (the form opens normally, just without auto-opening the composer). Correctly deferred - both are on this task's do-not-edit list - and documented in addmode-verification.md §3 and §7. Fold the one-line bump into the merge step; wiadomosci.html is already modified in this tree by the chat work.
